mapping.title: Authorized Access Control
mapping.notes: Host shows local identities & group membership; full closure requires documented access authorization + account management process in governance portal.

mapping.title: Transaction & Function Control
mapping.notes: Typically requires application/system-specific role/permission model and procedures; not provable from OS evidence alone.

mapping.title: Least Privilege
mapping.notes: Use secpol user-rights and admin group membership to show least-privilege enforcement; RSOP demonstrates enforcement via policy.

mapping.title: Non-Privileged Account Use
mapping.notes: Host evidence shows privilege boundaries; closure also needs policy/procedure requiring non-privileged use for routine tasks.

mapping.title: Privileged Functions
mapping.notes: User Rights Assignment (Se* rights) + admin membership demonstrate restriction of privileged functions.

mapping.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
mapping.notes: Account lockout policy + failed logon events support enforcement.

mapping.title: Privacy & Security Notices
mapping.notes: Interactive logon legal notice settings (and RSOP) show notice configured.

mapping.title: Session Lock
mapping.notes: Machine inactivity timeout / screen saver lock evidence.

mapping.title: Session Termination
mapping.notes: OS evidence supports automatic lock; full termination details depend on system/app session management expectations.

mapping.title: Control Remote Access
mapping.notes: Host shows RDP/remote services posture and firewall; full closure needs org-approved remote access methods + MFA/IdP configuration evidence.

mapping.title: Remote Access Confidentiality
mapping.notes: Partial: shows TLS posture for Windows; confidentiality of remote access typically requires VPN/TLS config evidence and policy.

mapping.title: Remote Access Routing
mapping.notes: Typically network architecture/boundary routing control; not host-provable from single Windows VM.

mapping.title: Privileged Remote Access
mapping.notes: Host shows privileged group membership + remote access settings; closure requires MFA and privileged access management evidence.

mapping.title: Audit Record Creation & Retention
mapping.notes: Event log configuration + audit policy shows audit records are created; retention relies on log size/retention settings in wevtutil outputs.

mapping.title: Audit Record Content / Traceability
mapping.notes: Samples show user-linked events; audit policy shows categories enabled.

mapping.title: Review and Update Logged Events
mapping.notes: Host shows what is logged; closure requires governance record of periodic review/update decisions.

mapping.title: Audit Log Review/Analysis/Reporting
mapping.notes: Requires documented process + review records/tickets; not provable from config snapshot alone.

mapping.title: Audit Log Correlation
mapping.notes: Typically SIEM/central log correlation evidence.

mapping.title: Audit Reduction and Report Generation
mapping.notes: Typically SIEM tooling evidence; not from host snapshot.

mapping.title: Time Stamps
mapping.notes: W32Time configuration and event timestamps evidence.

mapping.title: Protect Audit Information
mapping.notes: Security.evtx ACL + log config supports protection.

mapping.title: Audit Management Restricted
mapping.notes: ACLs and privilege assignments indicate restricted management; verify Event Log service permissions.

mapping.title: Audit Failure Alert
mapping.notes: Host evidence can show logging service status; closure typically requires monitoring/alerting evidence (SIEM/EDR).

mapping.title: Baseline Configuration & Inventory
mapping.notes: Provides current-state inventory/baseline snapshot; governance portal should store approved baseline + change history.

mapping.title: Security Configuration Settings
mapping.notes: Shows enforceable security settings and RSOP proof.

mapping.title: Change Control
mapping.notes: Requires change tickets/approvals/logs; implement in governance portal.

mapping.title: Security Impact Analysis
mapping.notes: Requires documented assessment/approval records.

mapping.title: Least Functionality
mapping.notes: Evidence of installed roles/services and listening ports supports least functionality discussions.

mapping.title: Configuration Settings for User-Installed Software
mapping.notes: AppLocker + privilege restrictions can enforce; closure may require governance policy on allowed software.

mapping.title: Whitelisting / Restrict Executable Code
mapping.notes: If AppLocker is enabled and enforced; verify effective policy content within this file.

mapping.title: Install Only Authorized Software
mapping.notes: Inventory supports; closure needs approved software list + enforcement story.

mapping.title: Control and Monitor User-Installed Software
mapping.notes: Supports restriction via privileges and inventory; closure needs monitoring process evidence.

mapping.title: Identify Users/Processes/Devices
mapping.notes: Unique local identities and domain join status.

mapping.title: Authenticate Users/Processes/Devices
mapping.notes: OS auth configuration evidence; full closure includes IdP/MFA and authentication methods policy.

mapping.title: Multi-factor Authentication for Network Access
mapping.notes: Requires IdP/Entra Conditional Access, VPN/RDP gateway MFA evidence (outside host).

mapping.title: Replay-Resistant Authentication
mapping.notes: Typically smart card/cert-based auth; needs IdP/device auth evidence.

mapping.title: Use of PKI Certificates
mapping.notes: Needs certificate infrastructure evidence.

mapping.title: Password Complexity & Change
mapping.notes: net accounts + secpol export show password policy; RSOP ties to policy enforcement.

mapping.title: Password Reuse Restriction
mapping.notes: Password history settings in account policy/secpol.

mapping.title: Temporary Passwords
mapping.notes: Procedural requirement (one-time/temporary password handling).

mapping.title: Disable/Lock Inactive Accounts
mapping.notes: Host can show enabled/disabled + last logon; closure requires account lifecycle process evidence.

mapping.title: Password Maximum/Minimum Age
mapping.notes: Account policy fields for min/max age.

mapping.title: Obscure Authenticator Feedback
mapping.notes: Windows auth UX settings evidence (best-effort); assessors often accept OS default behavior + policy reference.

mapping.title: Boundary Protection
mapping.notes: Host firewall evidence supports; full boundary story typically includes network firewall/NSG exports.

mapping.title: Public Access Separation
mapping.notes: Requires network architecture and segmentation evidence.

mapping.title: Cryptographic Protection
mapping.notes: Shows TLS and FIPS posture; full closure includes system/application crypto usage decisions.

mapping.title: Transmission Confidentiality/Integrity
mapping.notes: Partial from OS; depends on protocols/services used.

mapping.title: FIPS-Validated Cryptography
mapping.notes: Shows Windows FIPS policy enabled (note: validate module boundary in governance narrative).

mapping.title: Protect CUI at Rest
mapping.notes: BitLocker status supports confidentiality of data at rest.

mapping.title: Flaw Remediation
mapping.notes: Host patch level evidence; closure needs vuln/patch management process records.

mapping.title: Malicious Code Protection
mapping.notes: Defender enabled + preferences.

mapping.title: Security Alerts/Advisories
mapping.notes: Requires process evidence for monitoring advisories and acting on them.

mapping.title: Update Malicious Code Protection
mapping.notes: Signature age supports updates.

mapping.title: Periodic Scanning
mapping.notes: Scan age shows scans run; pair with policy for cadence if needed.

mapping.title: Monitor Communications for Attacks
mapping.notes: Usually IDS/IPS/EDR/SIEM evidence.

mapping.title: Identify Unauthorized Use
mapping.notes: Host telemetry supports detection; closure requires monitoring and response workflow records.
